droppedRules.why: The demo page's grid backdrop; the desktop paints its own, and every app page its own.
Sets every form in a monospace face.
Inverts a field to white on black while it has the focus, which leaves a chat composer black.
The same inversion for text areas.
Hides every checkbox and radio for labels the desktop does not draw.
The library's 40px close and resize boxes; the theme draws the title bar's controls on the contract's window-control part.
Spacing between the demo page's form rows, selected by class name.
A background window's bar at its own height, with a 1.5rem title; the theme draws a background window's bar itself, at the --desk-title-bar-height metric.

system.css bundles ChicagoFLF, ChiKareGo2, FindersKeepers and a Monaco revival under no license this theme can confirm (Monaco is Apple's typeface), so the theme ships no font files; its type comes from installed faces through its own --font-* tokens.

droppedDeclarations.why: 18px type and fixed widths sized for the library's demo page; the interface sizes its own.
Fields bring their own padding, which leaves room for an icon inside them.
A 20px side padding would push the icon out of the interface's square icon buttons.
A window is placed and sized by the desktop, and its page is a frame laid under its chrome, so the window paints no background or border over it.
Demo-page heading sizes (h2 at twice the body); the interface and its apps size their own.
The title bar's type size is the theme's.
The title bar's height is the --desk-title-bar-height metric, and its stripes are drawn by the theme so they stop at the controls.
The library's faces are its bundled ones, which the theme does not ship; the theme sets its type through --font-sans, --font-display and --font-mono, on the parts it styles.
